description: Basic test: File modified externally between read and edit, system retries
prompt:
1. Read src/config.js to see the current content:
<context-item use="read-file">
{"path": "src/config.js"}
</context-item>

2. Edit the file using replace-text to change RETRY_COUNT:
<action execute="replace-text">
{"path": "src/config.js", "old_str": "export const RETRY_COUNT = 3;", "new_str": "export const RETRY_COUNT = 5;"}
</action>

NOTE: The test framework will modify src/config.js externally AFTER you read it but BEFORE your edit executes. The system should detect this, show a retry message, and succeed with fresh content.
